title: New Paranormal Activity Movie Delayed to October 2027
excerpt: The new Paranormal Activity movie moves from May 21 to October 22, 2027. Here is what the Halloween delay and the return to the original house mean for fans.
content:
The new Paranormal Activity movie is delayed to October 2027. On November 6, 2026, Paramount moved the untitled film from May 21, 2027 to October 22, 2027, according to TheWrap. Bloody Disgusting, citing Deadline, reported the same shift that day.

The studio paired the news with a date for Danny McBride’s G.I. Joe, now set for October 20, 2028. Ian Tuason (Undertone) writes and directs. Oren Peli produces for Solana Films, while James Wan and Jason Blum produce for Blumhouse Atomic. Paramount co-finances and distributes worldwide.

New Paranormal Activity Movie Delayed October 2027, and Halloween Wins

A five-month delay usually smells like trouble. This one smells like a homecoming. During its theatrical run, Paranormal Activity became an October tradition. Fans learned to expect a new tape around Halloween.

The franchise’s rough patch proves the point. Bloody Disgusting’s November 6 report points to diminishing returns. The Marked Ones arrived in January 2014, and The Ghost Dimension followed in October 2015. Then the series left theaters entirely. Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin debuted on Paramount+ in 2021.

So the October 22 date matters twice over. It brings the brand back to cinemas, and it parks the film in the corridor the series once owned. The stakes are real, too. TheWrap’s November 6 report says the original grossed nearly $194 million worldwide. The seven-film franchise has grossed more than $900 million globally.

Could a May horror release have worked? Sure. But a movie about a haunted house and a camera on a tripod plays best when the nights get long.

Back to the House Where It All Started

The bigger news arrived a month earlier. Blumhouse held its New York Comic Con panel on October 9, 2026. There, the film was revealed to take place in Peli’s original house. Dread Central reported the reveal that day, and Complex reports that Wan confirmed it.

That choice is smarter than it sounds. Peli first shot the original for about $15,000, per Dread Central, so the house did most of the heavy lifting. Found footage at its best turns a home into a crime scene. A bedroom door and a dark stairwell became threats because they looked like ours.

Domestic fear is the oldest engine in haunted-house horror, as the Poltergeist legacy shows. Returning to a famous address can also go badly. The Amityville Horror remake is the cautionary tale.

What a familiar house offers is memory. Viewers will scan every corner for traces of the first film, and that hunt is half the fun. Just keep expectations in check. Paramount has not announced a title, and nobody has confirmed that Katie or Micah return. Plot details remain unconfirmed, so treat any synopsis you see as rumor.

Can Ian Tuason Make Silence Scary Again?

In my view, Tuason is an inspired pick. Undertone is audio-driven horror, and this franchise lives on what you hear while nothing moves. The original’s scariest moments are static shots and a thump down the hall.

Paranormal Activity is surveillance horror at heart. A camera sits still, and you search the frame for change. A director who makes sound carry dread could make those long takes feel unbearable again. That is my opinion, of course, since nobody outside the production has seen a frame.

The cast is fresh. Chase Yi and Sonia Mena star alongside Maya Da Costa. The producers link past and present. Peli returns through Solana Films, while Wan and Blum produce under Blumhouse Atomic, newly renamed from Blumhouse-Atomic Monster.

Tuason also inherits a genre that never really died. Anthologies like the V/H/S series kept found footage alive while this franchise drifted to streaming.

Final Thoughts

I’ll take the wait. Five extra months is a small price for a Paranormal Activity film that opens in theaters at Halloween. The later sequels hit diminishing returns, and the last one skipped theaters. Going back to one house and one camera is the right instinct.

My worry is the blank space. Without a title or a story, Paramount is selling a feeling. I hope Tuason trusts silence over jump scares. If he does, October 22, 2027 could reunite a Paranormal Activity crowd holding its breath in the dark.
